description: §21.3 / §21.4 — a cycle with one re-export edge and one import edge (x.scrml `export { B } from './y.scrml'`; y.scrml `import { A } from './x.scrml'`) fires E-IMPORT-002. x.scrml and y.scrml are aux siblings (`files` convention).
rationale: §21.3: "The compiler SHALL detect cycles in the import graph before any stage runs and report all files in the cycle." Import and re-export edges are one graph: a cycle mixing the two is still a cycle (S458 review F1).
